newsitem.title: UK: World Telecom Plc shares rise on AIM debut.
newsitem.headline: World Telecom Plc shares rise on AIM debut.

text.p: Shares in telephone charge card producer World Telecom Plc traded at a premium on their first day on the London Stock Exchange's Alternative Investment Market (AIM) on Thursday.
By 1515 GMT the shares were quoted at 170p, 20p above their issue price of 150p, although no trade was recorded in the stock.
A company spokesman said World Telecom raised 7.1 million stg of new money with the issue, which was three times oversubscribed. At the issue price the company was valued at 32.3 million stg.
The proceeds from the float, sponsored by Collins Stewart, will be used for investment, human resources, advertising and marketing, the spokesman said.
